bestBets.overview: A dour 1500m Provincial Maiden Handicap to kick off proceedings. No surprise to see the market latch onto the Stephen O?Halloran-trained COPARTNER PEGASUS. Deep into the prep now, fitness no issue and looks to finally have found his race after four career placings from ten starts. CORAL COVE is another knocking on the door, with more improvement to come than the favourite and maps well. MR REIBY could be a sharp improver up in trip, plain late last start but is looking for a trip. CAPE DOUGLAS has put in back-to-back sound efforts, smart last-start SP and is ready to win also.

raceTips.comment: Copartner Pegasus has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited by the expected race shape, with the early speed to settle handy and be given every chance in the straight. Mr Reiby has been racing consistently and should appreciate a genuine tempo, maps to land in a comfortable position and can run into the placings with the right luck. Coral Cove has the ability to make an impact when able to settle and conserve energy early, expect this runner to be saved for one strong sprint late. Cape Douglas is another who can be competitive if able to find cover, has enough tactical speed to hold a forward position and should be kept safe for exotics.

bestBets.overview: Intriguing contest. MY CHARM got run off her feet first up at Canterbury. She quickly drops back in grade and rises in trip to the 1800m. The cherry on top is the booking of James McDonald. HIGHBORN HARRY has the fitness advantage, deep into the prep but brings back-to-back winning figures to this event. The danger overall. IVY LEGEND has been poor in her last two starts, but go back to her win three back and that figure has her winning this event. The last-start winner BINKOU is on the quick back-up and rounds out the numbers.

raceTips.comment: Highborn Harry has been building a solid profile and looks suited by the way this race is likely to be run, with enough tactical speed to settle handy and produce a strong finish. Binkou has been racing honestly and should appreciate getting cover in the early stages, can conserve energy before being asked for an effort at the business end. My Charm possesses enough ability to keep this field honest and maps for a favourable run, with a steady tempo likely to allow this runner to build momentum. Ivy Legend can improve with a more economical run in transit, has the strength to sustain a long run and should be considered for the minor placings.

Has since had a trial to keep him ticking over and expect he will roll forward and give them something to chase. ITS A KNOCKOUT should be ready to peak now, draws nicely and gets in with very little weight. Expecting she can be right in the finish. NARBOLD gets back in his races and usually needs a bit of luck. bestBets.overview: A very tricky race to round out the card. GUS THE GREAT was a dominant winner last start at Gosford and looks to have come back in good order this prep. This is tougher, but expect he can continue to improve and be right in the finish. SOCIABLE looks a leading chance here after hitting the line strongly last start at Wyong. That form has held up nicely. If KWIRKY SMILE gets a run here, he looks to be a genuine contender dropping back in grade after running on strongly last start. AUSBRED HED?N?TAIL caught the eye first up at Newcastle, getting a long way back before finishing off strongly. Strips fitter now and looks suited stepping up in trip.

raceTips.comment: Kwirky Smile has been showing enough in recent outings to warrant plenty of respect, maps for a soft run and can be produced at the right time. Gus The Great has the ability to stay in the contest for a long way and should be suited if able to find a rhythm early, giving this runner an opportunity to fight on strongly. Ausbred Hed'n'tail can be competitive with the right tempo, possesses enough strength to keep finding the line and is capable of running into the placings.
